description: This Java class defines a service named RespondService that extends IntentService. It is responsible for handling the system intent ACTION_RESPOND_VIA_MESSAGE when the app is the default SMS app, allowing quick replies via message.

classes.name: RespondService
classes.description: A service that handles system intents related to responding via SMS when the app is set as the default SMS application.

methods.name: RespondService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with the tag 'RespondService'.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents; checks if the intent is for responding via message and if the app is the default SMS app, then processes accordingly (currently marked TODO).
